name: Homes & Tenancies
title: Free landlord certificate and tenancy tracker
description: Every home you let, who lives there, and every check and certificate with its date and official source, for England, the Netherlands and Germany. Free, private, no AI.
h1: Every check and certificate, with its date.
lead: Each home you let, its tenancy and your country's duties: the gas check, the energy label, the smoke alarms, and the copy the tenant must get and by when. Each rule links to its official page.
features: Your country's duties, built in
England, the Netherlands and Germany: each duty with how often it comes back, its official source and the date Busy last checked it.
The copy the tenant is owed
Record a check and Busy shows when the tenant must have a copy, for example within 28 days of a gas safety check in England.
Check-in and check-out
Room by room, with photos, meter readings and keys. At the end, Busy lays the two reports side by side and marks what got worse.
Your rental on a page
The home, the tenancy, the next dates and what is in order, as one PDF.
steps: Add the home you let
Its address and its country: Busy loads that country's duties.
Add who lives there
The start date, the rent and the deposit.
Record what is done
The last gas check or energy label: Busy keeps the next date.
faq: Which countries does it know?
England, the Netherlands and Germany. In any other country, Busy keeps your homes, rent, deposits, costs and letters, without country dates.
Is this legal advice?
No. Busy states each rule plainly, links the official source and shows the date it was last checked. For advice, ask a solicitor, an accountant or your landlords' association.
Where is my data?
In a folder you choose on your own computer, as plain files. Nothing is sent to us.

name: Rent & Deposits
title: Free rent tracker and deposit dates for landlords
description: What came in, what is late, and where each deposit stands: the cap, the date to protect or return it, and the earliest rent review. Free, private, no AI.
lead: Mark the rent as paid, see what is still open, give a receipt as a PDF, and keep each deposit within its country's rules and dates.
features: Paid in one tap
Each month's rent with its payment day. A month counts as late only after its payment day.
Receipts as PDF
A rent receipt for the tenant, with the month, the amount and the home.
The deposit and its dates
The cap for your country, the 30 days to protect it in England, and the date to return it in the Netherlands.
The earliest rent review
When a new rent may start under your country's rule, with the official source.
steps: Add the tenancy
The rent, the payment day and the deposit.
Mark each month as paid
Busy shows what is open and since when.
Keep the deposit right
Protected in time, returned in time, with what was kept back and why.
faq: How big may a deposit be?

England: at most 5 weeks' rent, or 6 weeks when the rent is £50,000 a year or more. The Netherlands: at most 2 months' bare rent. Germany: at most 3 months' rent without the service-charge advance. Busy shows the cap for your home.
Does Busy collect the rent?
No. Busy keeps the record. The rent goes from your tenant to you as it does now.
Is it free?
Yes, with no account and no AI.

name: Letters to Tenants
title: Free letter templates for landlords, in six languages
description: A welcome, a visit, a repair, a copy of a certificate and the deposit at the end: filled in from your records, in the language you choose for each tenant. Busy drafts; you send.
h1: The right letter, already filled in.
lead: Pick the letter and the tenancy. Names, the address, the rent and the dates are filled in, in the language you choose for that tenant: English, Dutch, German, Spanish, Italian or Portuguese. What Busy cannot know stays in brackets.
features: Five letters
A welcome, a visit to the home, a repair, a copy of a certificate, and the deposit at the end.
In six languages, you choose
It starts in the home's country's language, and you can pick another for each tenant. The rules stay those of the home's country.
As a PDF
Saved in your folder, ready to print or attach.
You send it
Busy drafts and never sends anything. The record shows when it went.
steps: Pick a letter
And the tenancy it is for.
Fill in the brackets
What Busy cannot know, such as the time of a visit.
Make the PDF
Send it the way you always do, and note the date.
faq: Are the letters legal documents?
No. They are plain, polite templates, not advice. For a notice with legal effect, use your country's official form or ask a professional.
Which languages?
English, Dutch, German, Spanish, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese. A letter starts in the home's country's language; you choose another for each tenant, and Busy remembers it.
Is it free?
Yes, with no account and no AI.

name: Costs & the Tax Year
title: Free rental income and costs tracker for landlords
description: Costs per home with the receipt, and the year's totals per home: rent in and costs by kind, as a list and a CSV for your accountant. Busy never files anything.
h1: The tax year, already added up.
lead: Add a repair, the insurance or the agent's fee with its receipt. At the end of the year, each home's rent and costs are totalled: in England's tax year from 6 April, elsewhere by calendar year.
features: Costs by kind
Repairs, insurance, service charges, utilities and fees, each with its home and its receipt.
Your country's tax year
England from 6 April to 5 April; the Netherlands and Germany by calendar year.
Totals per home
Rent in, costs and the difference, per home and per year.
For the accountant
One CSV with every home and every kind of cost.
steps: Add costs as they come
With the receipt and the home.
Mark the rent as paid
In Rent & Deposits: it counts here too.
Export the year
A list and a CSV for your return or your accountant.
faq: Does Busy say what is deductible?
No. Busy totals what you recorded. Which costs count, and how, is for your tax office's guidance or your accountant.
Does Busy file my tax return?
No. It prepares the figures; you or your accountant file.
Is it free?
Yes, with no account and no AI.
